method: Compared PostgreSQL 18 Row Security Policies, CREATE POLICY and Configuration Settings with the lesson and OWASP Authorization Cheat Sheet. Ran the 12-assertion offline verifier and the SQLite model tests (7/7); no provider or external network calls. The illustrative PostgreSQL policy was reviewed against the documentation but not executed. Isolated production build generated 399 static pages; Pagefind indexed 399 pages / 15,393 words. Light/dark full-page screenshots were visually inspected at 1300px: viewport/document width=1300px, article=792px, Mermaid rendered; one console error was the page favicon 404.

checks: RLS USING and WITH CHECK boundaries checked against PostgreSQL 18 CREATE POLICY documentation
Transaction-local setting lifecycle and identity trust limitation stated
Owner update authorization returns no document body
Cross-tenant read is denied without returning body
Illustrative PostgreSQL policy was not executed

limitations: No real PostgreSQL 18 server, role grants, RLS policy execution, connection pool, SQL injection path, or IdP was tested.
The SQLite fixture does not establish production authorization or concurrency safety; historical provider observations were not rerun.
The sole browser console error was a missing favicon (404); no lesson rendering errors were observed.
